long_biography.plain_text:
Tom Murphy turned five decades of Florida contracting experience towards a composite building system assembled from interlocking blocks. As a Renco USA co-founder, he helped guide more than a decade of testing before the system's first American apartment project. Eleven workers erected its walls, floors and roofs with moulded components, adhesive and hand tools, avoiding conventional masonry and welding.

The long development suited Murphy's preference for refining practical details. Renco's president credited him with persevering through repeated redesigns and certification work, while Murphy says finished buildings are what keep him engaged in construction. After transferring Coastal Construction's chief-executive responsibilities to his sons, he remains chairman of the executive board.
